/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64/bin/java -jar "$JAR" \
>"$RUN/java/game.log" 2>&1 </dev/null &

seed-survey.title: Seed sweep — boot both clients, enumerate a surface, one ledger item per element, classify with one action pair
seed-survey.when: The ledger needs seeding or extension from live surface: seeding.last_sweep is null, a run revealed a fork with no items, or the operator asks for a seed sweep.
pre: Both clients launchable on display :10 (java-reference-leg launch steps; boot-and-identity Godot steps).
Java window normalized to 1152x648; the Godot game is the embedded 1152x648 viewport.

One surface (or one depth level) per sweep — do not chase the whole tree in one run.
success: One frame pair per classified element + surface pair, non-blank; `seed/diff-NN.json` metrics in the item.
Every element item has `path`/`parent`/`discovered_by`; matches `verified.mode: "seed"`; divergences `mismatch` + both frames + both legs' calls.
`seeding.last_sweep` updated; frontier = only unswept forks; clients at a known state (or stopped).
steps:
Create sweep run + launch both legs: `java-reference-leg` §Steps 1–3 (detached launch, readiness, unmaximize/resize/raise/capture) + `boot-and-identity` §Steps 1–6 (bridge, identity, `game.tscn`, play, pid); stamp both pids in `$RUN/run.json` + normalized Java geometry:
`RUN="runs/$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)-seed-<area>"`
`mkdir -p "$RUN/seed"`

Capture root/surface pair + gate (surface-render check; closes the surface item, e.g. PAR-0001 boot):
`capture_screen.py --window-title Mindustry --output "$RUN/seed/step-01-<surface>-java.png"`
`godot_screenshot {"action":"game"}    # copy the returned file to "$RUN/seed/step-01-<surface>-godot.png"`
`frame_diff.py --java "$RUN/seed/step-01-<surface>-java.png" --godot "$RUN/seed/step-01-<surface>-godot.png" --out-json "$RUN/seed/diff-01.json"`

Java: the capture IS the enumeration — read the image, list labels/rows/icons with capture-relative center; click = capture `region` origin + image offset; no OCR; hover probe (move, capture, diff) for unplaceable controls; re-measure after resize; never reuse older-run coords. Godot: one loop-free eval, centers in viewport coords (swap class for `Range`, `LineEdit`, ...); match by label + semantics; one-side-only element = finding, not rounding error:
`godot_exec {"action":"eval","params":{"code":"var root = get_node(\"/root/Spine/Ui/UiRoot\")\nvar rows = root.find_children(\"*\", \"Button\", true, false).filter(func(b): return b.is_visible_in_tree()).map(func(b): return {\"path\": str(b.get_path()), \"text\": str((b as BaseButton).text), \"center\": (b as Control).get_global_rect().get_center()})\nreturn {\"pid\": OS.get_process_id(), \"buttons\": rows}"}}`

One ledger item per element/action before classifying: `id` (next `PAR-####`), `title`, `surface`, `parent` (fork item, `null` at root), `status: "seeded"`, `chain` (`chains/<area>-<element>.md`), `discovered_by` = run dir, `path` = boot replay (exact calls, `java` then `godot`) + `path.confirm` (how the fork proves itself). In-game actions (move, shoot, mine, place, drag, rotate, select, pause, skip wave) are items too: `path` ends at a deterministic world (e.g. `ground-zero-fresh-launch`), `steps` carry the input.

Classify each with one action pair (stop at the first dialog/menu; no deeper chaining). Java (raise first): menu buttons may consume the first click as hover -> verify in the capture, second click same point before concluding a miss. Godot (center from step-3 listing; one discrete call per event, then flush). Gate per parity-eval skill §4: pass -> `status: verified`, `verified: {mode: "seed", date, run}`; fail -> `status: "mismatch"` + step, both frames, diff JSON, both legs' calls; fix flow reproduces the recorded stop once, then fixes; the sweep never edits code:
`window_ctl.py raise Mindustry`
`java_input.py move X Y`
`java_input.py click X Y left`
`capture_screen.py --window-title Mindustry --output "$RUN/seed/step-NN-<element>-java.png"`
`godot_input {"action":"mouse_motion","params":{"position":{"x":X,"y":Y},"coords":"viewport"}}`
`godot_input {"action":"mouse_button","params":{"button":"MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT","position":{"x":X,"y":Y},"coords":"viewport","pressed":true}}`
`godot_input {"action":"mouse_button","params":{"button":"MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT","position":{"x":X,"y":Y},"coords":"viewport","pressed":false}}`
`godot_exec {"action":"eval","params":{"code":"Input.flush_buffered_events()\nvar h = get_tree().root.gui_get_hovered_control()\nreturn {\"pid\": OS.get_process_id(), \"hovered\": (\"\" if h == null else str(h.get_path()))}"}}`
`godot_screenshot {"action":"game"}    # copy to "$RUN/seed/step-NN-<element>-godot.png"`
`frame_diff.py --java "$RUN/seed/step-NN-<element>-java.png" --godot "$RUN/seed/step-NN-<element>-godot.png" --out-json "$RUN/seed/diff-NN.json"`

Return both clients to the fork before the next element + confirm: Java `java_input.py keydown escape` + `java_input.py keyup escape` (split calls; each action re-activates the window) or Back/cancel; Godot `godot_input`/close. Re-capture/re-list, assert unchanged. Destructive entries (Quit, Abandon): classify on the confirm dialog, then cancel — never complete them.

Fork children: a new surface (Play → submenu; Campaign → planet page; sector → HUD) -> append to `seeding.frontier`; write controls as items whose `path` extends the current one with that action's calls; don't classify children this sweep; one depth level allowed -> descend once + repeat steps 2–6.

Teardown/docs: quit Java gracefully (`java-reference-leg` §Steps 5); stop Godot if the sweep is over; `seeding.last_sweep` = this run; pop the swept frontier entry; `report.md` (surface, elements, matches, mismatches, new ids, enumeration method); commit docs only.
